seed_world_description: I don't want to talk about what happened in the past, Master! These were wonderful, amazing, incomparable places. Golden fields, mirror-like rivers and lakes. It was a special place, with its own aura, charms and flaws...
seed_family_description: My parents weren't the richest people. They worked hard in the fields just to feed us. And they are wonderful people, with infinitely generous souls. It's a shame we won't meet them again. But they know very well that I love them with all my heart and soul.
seed_occupation_description: Since it so happens that I am now a slave, I am ready to accept it and forget about the past. I will accept you with all my heart and soul, if you will be at least a little humane to me. This is my only request of you, Master. And I am ready to do anything for you. I will try to be the best in everything for you. So I listen and I obey...
